title: Criminal was no 'victim'
article: A letter from Chris Gobeil, Kingston.
Re: Police identify shootout victim, March 12, and How a career criminal fooled the system, March 13.

I was disgusted by your March 12 headline that characterized Daniel Lamer as a "victim" of a "shootout." This was an affront to Mr. Lamer's victims, namely Const. Dan Brisson and, as it turns out, Const. Richard Frohlich in Montreal 10 years earlier. Not to mention the people whose homes he broke into, and countless people who are terrorized by outlaw motorcycle gangs and the ruthless ways in which they deal in drugs and prostitution.
To the Citizen's credit, you put the story back into some sort of balance the following day by profiling the life and death of a heartless career criminal who thought nothing of taking another life.
All the same, the story on March 12 was hasty and unbalanced. What was lost is that Mr. Lamer was only a victim of himself, not the police.
